## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Engine plugin (`feat(engine):`)
- [ ] Docs (`docs:`)

## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest -m "not network"` passes locally
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format .` applied
- [ ] Type hints added for new public code
- [ ] Docstrings for public APIs
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (if user-facing)
- [ ] New engine plugin includes `config_schema` and self-healing selectors
